answer: Clone operators mint cheap identities that harvest attest fees before any reserve is actually at risk. I would force each joiner to freeze 2.9 POA in a glacier vault that releases 25% only every epoch after they post 7 job bills at an open wharf registry and then wait a 36-hour unpaid ledge. That costs the locked 2.9 POA plus a 0.08 POA missed-window fee. Any peer can audit thaw by matching public dock bills to funding hop-distance. If two bills collapse to the same hop inside 18 hours, slash 45% of the vault and rewind the ledge, which stops a farm from thawing as one batch.
